decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system draws directly on the firm's office furniture and engineering know-how, and demand for flexible workplaces after the pandemic makes its results easy to read and improve through in-house R&D.

The soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's upholstery and material expertise, but it has had low prominence and has not been observed since 2019, so its future is less certain. Its closeness to the core still favours keeping and refining it.
The high standing table builds on the firm's existing office and conference table knowledge, so it can be maintained and adapted to flexible work settings at low cost.
